name: Edward Medard Conservation Park
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 23, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: 6140 Turkey Creek Road, Plant City, FL 33567
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Rent a canoe or kayak at the entry station ($25 for up to four hours, then $10 an hour, tax included) and paddle the reservoir, or walk the boardwalk to the observation platform. A 3-mile trail runs through pine flatwoods and hardwood hammock. The 1.4-mile Singing Bluffs trail (primitive, rated strenuous) is on this season's county Hiking Spree list, and Audubon birding hikes are held here. It is a reservoir, not a spring, so there is no clear-water swimming.
cost: $2 per vehicle (up to 8 people); canoe or kayak $25 for 4 hours; camping $24 a night
access: Open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. in fall and winter (8 to 7 in spring and summer). Entry by cash or card. The boat ramp is closed while the water district partly draws down the reservoir; the county says canoes and kayaks are not affected.
